incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: INC-2026-482 — ArborHealth (tenant: tenant_8421) on dedicated pool arbo-dp-3. Elevated 5xx rate from 03:14 UTC. Impact: latency + errors for ~12% of requests. On-call: Devon. Link: <https://console.redwood/in/INC-2026-482>
Devon (on-call): acked, jumping in. pulling logs now :eyes:
Sarah (eng-sre): I can help with log traces and request sampling. suspected KV cache eviction spiking when seq_len > 1024.
Raj (customer-success): FYI ArborHealth is on a HIPAA-adjacent contract. They just DM'd that they may need raw logs for a downstream investigation. heads-up: logs may contain PHI fields.
Devon (on-call): noted. we should NOT share raw logs without legal clearance. initial triage: 5xx correlates with model shard OOMs on node gpu-05, retry cascading.
Harper (eng-runtime): seeing elevated allocs on arbo-dp-3; rolling a quick config change to reduce batch_size from 16 -> 8 on that pool.
incident-bot: deploy-bot posted: Rolling config change to pool arbo-dp-3 by Harper. CI: passed. Starting canary rollout.
Oliver (support): cs-case created: CS-789201. Customer CSM alerted. they requested a temporary exception to retention so they can run their own forensics.
Maya (legal): :lock: we need a formal retention/redaction exception request from ArborHealth. If logs contain PHI, legal must approve a time-limited access window. Provide scope: tenant_8421, time range, storage, who has access, and audit plan.
Raj (customer-success): I have the customer's signed PO and a note that they'll only use logs to validate a specific transaction set. I'll ask them to submit a short request email right now.
Devon (on-call): triage note: can reproduce 500s locally by replaying requests hitting seq_len ~1200. Suggest we enable ephemeral detailed logging for a narrow time window and mask fields during export.
Lexi (security): Masking + ephemeral access is preferred. Proposed flow: create ephemeral S3 bucket with SSE-KMS (key: rwd-ephem-logs), grant read to 3 named engineers for 48h, run automated redaction script, customer can get sanitized export. Log all operations to audit-log.
Maya (legal): 48h is acceptable as a default. Need written customer consent and that they won't persist PHI beyond the window. We'll draft the approval email template now.
Raj (customer-success): customer emailed: "We authorize Redwood to provide log snippets for the transaction IDs we listed — we understand PHI risk. We'll not store raw logs." forwarding to thread.
Maya (legal): Received. Approve temporary access for 48 hours conditioned on: (1) minimal time range (we recommend 2 hours), (2) three named engineers only, (3) mandatory automated redaction run before any handoff to customer, (4) audit trail in console. I'll attach approval note to CS-789201.
Harper (eng-runtime): executing steps:
```
# fetch encrypted logs for tenant
rwd logs fetch --tenant tenant_8421 --since 2026-03-15T02:30Z --until 2026-03-15T04:30Z --pool arbo-dp-3 > /tmp/tenant_8421_slice.log
# run redaction
python tools/redact_phis.py /tmp/tenant_8421_slice.log > /tmp/tenant_8421_slice.redacted.log
# upload to ephemeral bucket (SSE-KMS)
aws s3 cp /tmp/tenant_8421_slice.redacted.log s3://rwd-ephem-logs/tenant_8421/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/rwd-ephem-logs
```
Harper (eng-runtime): granting temporary IAM role rwd-ephem-access to Devon, Sarah, Harper for 48h. will enable object-level logging.
Devon (on-call): running redaction now. small sample shows request payloads with patient_id and ssn-like numbers. redaction script replaces with "<REDACTED_ID>" — good. see sample below:
```
2026-03-15T03:01:12Z request_id=abc123 tenant=tenant_8421 payload={"patient_id":"<REDACTED_ID>", "notes":"cough, fever"}
2026-03-15T03:01:13Z response=200 latency_ms=112
```
Lexi (security): Adding a retention-exception ticket in infra: INFRA-RETAIN-452. Must include KMS key rotation check and ensure keys are not shared with customer. Also require HSM audit if requested later.
Maya (legal): I'll add a clause to the approval: customer must ack they won't request raw logs beyond this. Also require CS to get written sign-off and add to legal record.
Raj (customer-success): customer replied with signed ack. uploading to CS ticket.
Harper (eng-runtime): upload complete. bucket path: s3://rwd-ephem-logs/tenant_8421/2026-03-15_slice.redacted.log. ACL set to private, 3 engineers have GetObject, PutObject disabled. Access window expiry: 48h (until 2026-03-17T03:20Z UTC).
incident-bot: audit-log: retention-exception granted for tenant_8421 by Maya (legal). duration=48h. ticket=INFRA-RETAIN-452. cs_case=CS-789201.
Oliver (support): sent the sanitized export link to the customer with instructions and reminder not to persist logs. customer confirmed receipt and will validate.
Devon (on-call): after the rollback of canary change, errors dropped to baseline. postmortem: root cause = KV cache eviction + increased sequence length distribution. follow-up actions: 1) add seq_len guardrails on client-side, 2) tune autoscaler thresholds for arbo-dp-3, 3) add a redaction-safe log stream for future incidents.
Maya (legal): filing final approval memo into legal drive and closing the exception after 48h. please ensure audit entries exist for every access. I'll reopen if customer requests longer retention.
Sarah (eng-sre): noting on incident timeline and linking to postmortem. leaving handoff to morning on-call. Devon, I'm leaving an ops-runbook entry for ephemeral log flow.
Devon (on-call): thanks — handing off to day on-call. closing pager. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-482 status=resolved (degraded->ok). closing thread.
